data_source_statement: D2 uses only verified D1 outputs under data/processed/. No raw transaction file, legacy data, notebook, or fabricated data was read.

definitions.low_movement: bottom quartile of total units AND no stock depletion
definitions.zero_sales_sku: total units sold == 0 over the period

insights.business_implication: A concentrated demand contribution makes this SKU important to service-level planning.
insights.evidence: It represents 6.5% of 46,940 total units sold.
insights.recommended_action: Prioritize SKU04321 in forecast review and inventory monitoring.

insights.business_implication: Demand planning should account for calendar-period variation rather than use one flat average.
insights.evidence: The period total is 12,760 units in the computed season aggregation.
insights.observation: Season Autumn has the highest observed demand.
insights.recommended_action: Review replenishment coverage before the Autumn demand period.

insights.business_implication: Capital may be tied up in inventory with limited observed movement.
insights.evidence: The rule flags zero sales or bottom-quartile movement with no observed stock depletion.
insights.observation: 1240 SKU(s) meet the computed dead/slow-stock rule.
insights.recommended_action: Review these SKUs for markdown, assortment, or replenishment-policy changes.

insights.business_implication: The time trend should be monitored when setting future inventory targets.
insights.evidence: The fitted daily slope is 0.007 units per day.
insights.observation: Aggregate daily demand is increasing over the observed window.
insights.recommended_action: Compare future forecasts with this trend signal during review.

executive_summary.limitations: Computed from the official D1/D2 data only. No external or sample data was used.

top_movers.methodology: total units / average daily units (per SKU)

metrics.holiday_status: unavailable in D1 source; is_holiday remains missing

observations_for_downstream: Use observed weekly and category patterns as D3 forecast signals.
Review concentrated top-SKU demand and high-variability SKUs in D3 and D4.
Treat promotion and inventory coverage as context; correlation is not causation.
